description:
The `ComputeBackend` abstraction in `crates/gf2-core/src/compute/` has CPU implementations only.

## Background

The module documentation listed a HIP/ROCm `GpuBackend` as a later opt-in feature; the source-comment sweep removed that statement, and this issue tracks the decision. `@/inv/crate-dependency-direction` and `@/inv/unsafe-kernel-isolation` bound where GPU code may live.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A design record states whether `ComputeBackend` gains a GPU implementation and through which crate, or the backend abstraction is documented as CPU-only and the decision closes this issue.
title: Decide a GPU ComputeBackend for gf2-core
